description: Trigger a Modal function as a Dagster asset.

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Dagster asset key for this component.

modal_function.label: Modal Function
modal_function.description: Fully-qualified reference to the Modal function in the form ``app_name::function_name`` (SDK lookup) or ``module.path::function_name`` (CLI run). Used as a display label in asset metadata.

app_file.label: App File
app_file.description: Path to the Python file that defines the Modal app (e.g. ``ml/training_app.py``). Required for the CLI fallback path. Also used with the SDK when ``modal_function`` does not embed the app name.

function_name.label: Function Name
function_name.description: Name of the decorated ``@modal.function`` within ``app_file``. Required when using the CLI fallback (``modal run app_file::function_name``).

args.label: Args
args.description: Positional arguments forwarded to the Modal function.

kwargs.label: Kwargs
kwargs.description: Keyword arguments forwarded to the Modal function.

modal_token_id_env_var.label: Modal Token Id Env Var
modal_token_id_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the Modal token ID. When set, the component overrides the ``MODAL_TOKEN_ID`` subprocess environment variable or configures the SDK client accordingly.

modal_token_secret_env_var.label: Modal Token Secret Env Var
modal_token_secret_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable containing the Modal token secret. Paired with ``modal_token_id_env_var`` for non-default credential injection.

detach.label: Detach
detach.description: When True, fire-and-forget: the asset completes as soon as the function is dispatched without waiting for it to finish. Metadata will not include return values. Use with care — Dagster will mark the asset as materialised even if the Modal function subsequently fails.

environment_name.label: Environment Name
environment_name.description: Modal environment (workspace namespace) to target. Defaults to the environment configured in the active Modal profile.

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.

freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)
freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.

freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule
freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).

description.label: Description
description.description: Human-readable description surfaced in the Dagster UI.

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Upstream asset keys this asset depends on.

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage: output column → list of upstream columns it derives from, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}.

name: Modal Asset
